column6: Exercise step gap: [Q(√2,√3):Q]=4 alone does not prove x⁴−10x²+1 irreducible; added that Q(α)=Q(√2,√3). Squaring steps and the Q(√2) minimal polynomial x²−2√2x−1 check out.
Order-30 counts verified (24+20>30).
Order-56 count verified.
A₅ counts n₅=6, n₃=10, n₂=5 verified.
S₃ products verified right-to-left.
|a−b| table and a★b=a verified.
Z₄ regular permutations verified.
Right-multiplication bullet had the composition order backwards: ρ_gh is ρ_g followed by ρ_h (= ρ_h∘ρ_g), not ρ_h followed by ρ_g.
Claimed Z₃ could be represented more compactly than in S₃; false (Z₃ needs 3 points). Replaced with S₃ into S₆.
Same Z₃-in-S₃ "larger than necessary" example in the last paragraph; replaced with S₃ into S₆.
D₄ classes and 8=2+2+2+2 verified.
Order 72 count and Z/6×Z/12 conversion verified.
Units mod 20 squares verified: 9, 11, 19 have order 2.
(1 3)H and H(1 3) verified right-to-left.
στ=(1 2)(3 4), τσ=(1 3)(2 4) verified. New text uses right-to-left; older text (formula, Q0, Q1) uses left-to-right. Each states or implies its convention.
Odd count 1+2(j−i−1) of reversed factors verified.

Answer key wrong: Student B's (1 4)(2 4)(3 4)(1 4)(2 4) is not (1 2 3 4) in either composition order. Replaced with (1 2)(1 3)(2 4)(1 2)(2 4) (verified) and stated the left-to-right convention Student A's product needs.
Each transposition flips exactly one pair is false for non-adjacent transpositions; changed to an odd number of factors.
Powers of 3 mod 7 verified.
rs=(1 2)(3 4), sr=(1 4)(2 3)=r⁻¹s verified.
Explainer said all rotations are even and all reflections odd for every n; false (in D₄, r=(1 2 3 4) is odd and (1 2)(3 4) is an even reflection). Restricted the claim to D₃.
Order counts for Z₂×Z₄, Z₈, Z₂³ verified.
Most elements have two non-identity components is false for the cited Z₂×Z₃ (2 of 6) and for any G×Z₂; changed to "Many".
(1+√2)⁻¹=√2−1 verified.
F₄ arithmetic verified.
α¹…α⁷ in F₂[x]/(x³+x+1) verified, α⁷=1.
Kernel of evaluation at √2 on ℝ[x] is (x−√2), not (x²−2); ℝ[x]/(x²−2) ≅ ℝ×ℝ, not ℝ. Corrected.
x↦3x on Z₁₂ verified.
A coset has infinitely many representatives is false for finite groups. The answer also stated the converse direction as well-definedness, which contradicts the new explanation. Both corrected.
CRT map and kernel (2, x) verified.
Example used multiplication by 2 on Z, which is not a ring homomorphism (and Z is not ring-isomorphic to 2Z). Replaced with the inclusion Z→Q.
Core Idea said |Gal|=degree for separable extensions; false (Q(∛2)/Q is separable with |Gal|=1, as the file's own Q0 says). Changed to Galois.
Same "separable (and hence Galois)" error, plus the claim that only repeated roots cause a shortfall. Corrected to name normality.
Kernel of D₄ acting on the diagonals = {e, r², two diagonal reflections} verified.
